summary: Address the reader as 'you' instead of 'the user'; 'users' is fine for a group of other users.
questions: Should docs say 'the user must' or 'you must'?

answer_card.title: User vs you
answer_card.answer_md: Write **You must...**, not "The user must...". "Users" is fine for other people ("Other users may wish to access your database").
